mandatory_country_context.scope: Every retained message, including separately collected verified-author posts, must contain country context matching this block.
mandatory_country_context.name_forms: Rwanda is used in English, French and Kiswahili; Kinyarwanda also uses u Rwanda and the joined spelling uRwanda.
mandatory_country_context.hashtag_handling: #Rwanda is a quoted literal alternative, not an undocumented hashtag operator. Confirm the provider indexes the hashtag text; case handling follows the provider.

collection_policy.language_allowlist_applies_to: Original documents in all collection channels, including verified-author exports; Russian-language and other non-allowlisted documents are excluded.
collection_policy.if_filter_is_unavailable: Collect to a staging area, identify document languages and include only allowed-language documents in the corpus; do not claim the Boolean query enforces language.
collection_policy.mixed_or_undetermined_language: Hold uncertain labels for language review before inclusion. Include code-switching among the four allowed languages; exclude documents with substantive text in other languages.
collection_policy.kinyarwanda_not_supported: Record the missing coverage; obtain accessible local-source or verified-author exports rather than treating an English/French-only corpus as locally complete.

translation_and_attribution.video_audio: Retain original media URL, transcript language and timestamps for cited spans.
translation_and_attribution.political_context: Keep speaker, institution, subject of the position and audience context; an international-language address and a local-language address need not discuss the same political level.
translation_and_attribution.uncertain_political_meaning: Review in context and, when needed, with a competent speaker; do not turn an uncertain translation into a confident rating.
translation_and_attribution.low_detector_or_model_support: Keep the original in the review queue and verify its language before corpus inclusion; weak detector support alone is not a reason to reject Kinyarwanda.
